title: Wyoming’s Machu Picchu Is An Ancient 4,000-Year-Old Hidden In Wind River Range
description: A University of Wyoming archaeologist and his team discovered a sprawling ancient village high in the Wind River Range 20 years ago. The 4,000-year-old lodge sites, what they have called Wyoming's Machu Picchu, have helped redefine prehistoric life in the mountains.

description: The future of energy security lies in clean energy, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said while inaugurating and speaking at the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRESE) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam. He stated that continued heavy reliance on fossil fuels disrupts the global economy.
